title: Video clips, and never miss the notes

items.text: Missed a meeting? Its notes are one click from MatterMeet's Recent list, in the conversation and in your email, ready to copy or share.
On the web and desktop app, record a video clip of up to five minutes in the message box and send it like any file.
Every meeting of a repeating series stays on your Recent list, with who was invited and its notes.
Touch up and Low light give you a softer, brighter picture, and six colour tones set the mood.
Lots of small fixes: the Office shows only people still at your firm, menus fit small windows, and phone screens read better.
